item.title: Review: CDC reports six measles deaths in 2026 as US battles worst outbreak in 35 years
item.description: Figures highlight spread of virus, officially declared eliminated in US in 2000, but CDC does not identify which states accounted for deaths The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reported six measles-related deaths in the US this year, according to figures published on its website on Thursday, as the country faces its most severe resurgence of the disease in decades. The newly reported total is twice the number of deaths recorded in 2025, highlighting the spread of the highly infectious virus, which was officially declared eliminated in the US in 2000. item.description: ⚽️ WCL updates from 5.45pm GMT kick-off ⚽️ Live scoreboard | And email Simon Renée Slegers has a bit of a chat about the game, and about how injuries are impacting Arsenal’s squad: We have an incredible squad, we have a lot of depth in the squad. It’s always going to happen that you have absences. Of course we’re missing those players but we always have players who can step up. We need everyone, so the squad is ready for tonight. It’s a maze around the Camp Nou building site, and finding the media entrance involved a lot of confused stewards and different directions. We’re in though, and what a stadium it’s going to be when the work is done. It’s really hard to know how Arsenal will fare…
